title: Arrange seedling records in two rows
goal: Use table, tr and td to put plant names and quantities into their respective cells.
summary: table is a row, and each td in the row is a data cell. Rows must be placed into cells in the same order to compare data in the same column.
tasks: Replace two seedling records with a table, and create a tr in the order of mint and basil.
Put two td cells in each row. Use "Mint" and "6 basins" for mint, and "Basil" and "4 basins" for basil.

example.note: parking space record is written first with the entry and then with the quantity, so the quantity will be aligned in the second column.

hint: If only one column appears, check whether the name and quantity share a td. Each tr needs two separate td cells.
